pages.text: The $(item)Archery Target$() lies flat on the face you place it on. Power it with redstone and it stands up, ready for practice.

Every arrow that hits it sends a short redstone pulse: the closer to the bullseye, the stronger the signal, up to 15.$(br2)Read the strength with a comparator to build score boards, locks that only open for good shots, or a shooting gallery that resets on its own.
